Large Language Model (LLM) inference is divided into two distinct phases: **Prefill** (processing the input prompt) and **Decoding** (generating tokens one by one). While the prefill phase is typically compute-bound (limited by the TFLOPS of the GPU), the decoding phase is almost universally **memory-bandwidth bound**.
